facts: U.S. Customs dogs "Rocky" and "Barco" were so good at patrolling the border that Mexican drug lords put a $300,000 bounty on their heads.
In 2001, it was estimated that there are approximately 400 million dogs in the world.
Thomas Jefferson helped enact a dog tax in Virginia, because he was annoyed that dogs were killing his sheep.
Dogs have a wet nose to help them absorb scents.
A dog's sense of smell is so powerful that they can detect drugs and explosives.
